summary: Iter 7 (Final Product / Visual / Map / Plans / Privacy / Discovery) — Frontend-only verification. RESULT: All 7 review flows PASS on the Expo web preview (390x844). Signup happy-path lands Register(fill) → /location-privacy (testID location-privacy-screen, 'Continue' label because next=setup) → /plans (testID plans-screen, title 'Choose your Intro plan') → 'Continue Free' (testID plan-choose-free) → /intent (screen title 'What brings you to Intro?'). Radar top bar has BOTH testID current-vibe-pill (with chevron-down, tap opens /vibe) AND testID visibility-toggle showing 'Visible · 27m left' as Kauri Pro. Radar map (testID radar-map) renders map tiles with ring labels 50m/100m/175m/250m matching Kauri Pro 250m radius; testID radar-filters on the map top-right opens /privacy. Privacy radius locks: as Kauri Pro all 6 options 10/25/50/100/250/500 selectable (no lock glyph, opacity 1). Demo-login as sarah@intro.demo (plan=free, max_radius=50): options 10/25/50 unlocked, options 100/250/500 CORRECTLY show lock glyph (Ionicons lock-closed U+F3C7) + opacity 0.7 (chipLocked style). Save 50m works (PUT /users/me/state → 200). Profile tab shows testID my-plan-chip ('250m radius · Intro Pro · Visible' for Kauri); testID menu-plans opens /plans with 'Current Plan' chip on Pro card; testID menu-location-privacy opens /location-privacy with 'Got it' button label (non-setup mode). Demo upgrade to Plus verified via direct API (PUT /users/me/state {plan:plus} → 200 with updated user object). Nearby tab renders normally (filter chips, invisible-empty state when visibility off). No red-screen errors; only pre-existing shadow*/pointerEvents/useNativeDriver console warnings from theme.ts + RN-Web layer. Deprecated packages detected: NONE (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch).

minor.issue: Pydantic EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs like '.test' (returns 422 'value is not a valid email address: The part after the @-sign is a special-use or reserved name that cannot be used with email.'). Real users on real domains are unaffected. Consider a friendlier client-side error mapping.

context_for_next_testing_agent: React-Native Web Alert.alert polyfill: on web it renders a custom in-DOM modal (NOT window.confirm), so playwright's page.on('dialog') does NOT fire. The 'See plans' / 'Demo upgrade' / 'OK' buttons in Alert modals need to be located via role='button' and text content once the modal appears (they are inside a div overlay). During this run I could confirm the LOCK GLYPH + OPACITY:0.7 style on privacy chips (which is the visible proof the lock branch fires), and I directly verified the upgrade PUT /users/me/state {plan:plus} succeeds server-side. Signup flow needs a valid public-domain email — Pydantic EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs like '.test' with HTTP 422. Use '@intro.example.com' or a real gmail-like domain in tests. All iter_7 review-request testIDs exist and are wired: location-privacy-screen, privacy-got-it, plans-screen, plan-choose-free/plus/pro, plan-card-{free|plus|pro}, current-vibe-pill, visibility-toggle, radar-map, radar-filters, radar-recentre, radar-blip-{id}, radar-cluster-{key}, radius-option-{10|25|50|100|250|500}, save-privacy, my-plan-chip, menu-plans, menu-location-privacy, register-{name|email|password|age|18-checkbox|submit|error}.
